jobs.title: SAP Billing Consultant
jobs.description:
SAP Billing Consultant
 



 Remote we can try\- Good to have resources from Foster City or nearby.
 



**Billing Consultant** 




**Experience** 



* 10\-12\+ years of SAP SD/OTC experience, with 6\+ years focused on billing



**E\-Invoicing and DRC (Key Focus)** 



* End\-to\-end implementation of SAP DRC for e\-invoicing and statutory reporting
* Configuration and use of the eDocument Cockpit (EDOC\_COCKPIT) and eDocument framework
* Country\-specific e\-invoicing mandates such as Peppol, Italy SDI, Colombia, Romania e\-invoicing reform
* Both outbound (sales invoice) and inbound (supplier invoice) e\-invoicing processes
* Tracking regulatory changes and translating new mandates into system solutions
* Coordination with tax, legal, and finance teams on compliance requirements



**Core Billing** 



* Billing types, copy control, item categories, and billing relevance
* Invoice split and combination logic, collective billing, and billing due list
* Billing plans (periodic and milestone) and down payment processing
* Credit and debit memos, returns, cancellations, pro forma, and intercompany billing
* Settlement Management (condition contracts) replacing classic rebates
* BRF\+ based Output Management and Adobe Forms for invoices



**End\-to\-End OTC** 



* Business Partner, sales orders, pricing procedures, and condition techniques
* Credit management (FIN\-FSCM), delivery, and goods issue
* Accounts receivable, cash application, dispute management, and collections



**Finance Integration** 



* Revenue account determination (VKOA) and resolution of posting errors
* Tax determination and integration with external tax engines (Vertex, ONESOURCE, Avalara)
* CO\-PA / margin analysis, and revenue recognition under RAR (IFRS 15 / ASC 606\)
* Period\-end reconciliation between SD and FI



**S/4HANA Knowledge** 



* Simplification List, simplified data model, and Fiori billing apps
* SAP Activate methodology and fit\-to\-standard workshops
* SAP Best Practices scope items for OTC



**Technical Skills** 



* Writing functional specs for enhancements, forms, interfaces, and reports
* Conceptual knowledge of user exits, BAdIs, and copy/requirement routines
* IDocs and EDI (INVOIC) and third\-party system interfaces
* Data migration for open orders, billing plans, and rebate agreements



**Leadership and Soft Skills** 



* Leading business workshops and managing senior stakeholders
* Guiding onsite and offshore teams and reviewing deliverables
* Owning testing (SIT, UAT), cutover planning, and hypercare
* Preparing training materials and training key users



**Preferred** 



* SAP S/4HANA Sales certification
* Industry billing experience (resource\-related billing, consignment, third\-party, or SAP BRIM)
* Experience with multi\-country rollout

Job Description

SAP ABAP Developer (RICEFW \+ HANA \+ BRIM/FSCM)

Work Mode: Hybrid

Location: Pune, Mumbai

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled SAP ABAP Developer with expertise in RICEFW components, HANA development, and experience in BRIM/FSCM solutions. This role is pivotal in enhancing our SAP ecosystem, delivering efficient solutions that drive business outcomes and improve operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop robust SAP ABAP solutions, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows (RICEFW).

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirem\[10:59 am, 29/10/2026] \+91 93928 55742: nts and analyze system requirements to provide effective HANA and ABAP solutions.

Create and optimize HANA CDS views, attribute views, procedures, and perform HANA migrations and simplifications.

Implement integration solutions using various APIs like REST, SOAP, OData, and RFCs to ensure seamless data exchange across platforms.

Enhance SAP CRM and SOM components, leverage OOPs programming, and utilize BOL/GeniL programming for improved functionality.

Debug and resolve issues related to ODI, IDOCs, and event\-driven scenarios while ensuring efficient order management.

Partake in Fiori and Gateway development to improve user experience and ensure system compatibility with modern applications.

Requirements:

Minimum of 9\-12 years of experience in SAP ABAP design and development, with at least 8 years focused on RICEFW.

Proficient in HANA design and development, with a minimum of 2 years of experience.

Technical experience in SAP BRIM and familiarity with components such as Convergent Charging and Convergent Mediation.

Strong expertise in ABAP components: Smart Forms, Adobe Forms, BAPI, BADI, User Exit, and enhancements.

Hands\-on experience with data migration and integration tasks, particularly in HANA and CRM components.

Solid knowledge of Fiori\-based applications and experience with HANA migration and simplification.

Able to work in a distributed architecture with flexibility in scheduling; capability to overlap with US working hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with advanced SAP technologies, including AMDP and ADBC.

Certification in SAP HANA or advanced SAP ABAP modules.

Familiarity with Order Distribution Framework (ODI) and troubleshooting methodologies.

Proven track record of successful project delivery in a hybrid work environment.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with excellent communication skills.

Benefits:

Competitive salary package with potential for negotiation based on experience.

Hybrid work model requiring 2\-3 days in the office per week in Pune (Balewadi) or Mumbai (Kanjurmarg).

Opportunities for professional growth and skill development in cutting\-edge SAP technologies.

Access to health and wellness programs to support employee health and wellbeing.

Flexible working hours with a potential overlap of US time zones.

Engagement in a collaborative and innovative work environment focused on continuous improvement.

Pay: Up to ₹1,500,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra

**SAP Application Development (AD) \& Application Management Services (AMS) Manager**


**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**


Responsible for leading and governing SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across the enterprise SAP landscape, ensuring the successful delivery of enhancements, and support services aligned to business objectives.


The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers to ensure effective planning, prioritization, execution, and support of SAP solutions. The candidate will be accountable for driving service excellence, managing vendors and delivery teams, overseeing execution, and ensuring stable SAP operations across all business\-critical processes and modules.


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**


* Lead the delivery and governance of SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across multiple SAP modules and business functions.


* Act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers.


* Manage SAP continuous improvement initiatives from inception through deployment and stabilization.


* Ensure effective delivery of AMS services, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Release Management.


* Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, ticket backlogs, aging incidents, customer satisfaction metrics, and vendor performance.


* Drive prioritization and governance of project demands, enhancement requests, and production support activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.


* Collaborate with business process owners across functions including Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Customer Service to identify and deliver technology solutions.


* Coordinate cross\-functional solution delivery involving SAP modules such as SD, MM, PP, PM, FI/CO, EWM, BRIM, and other integrated solutions as applicable.


* Manage SAP AMS provider, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality, and delivery expectations are consistently achieved.


* Lead major incident management activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement initiatives.


* Support budget planning, resource management, capacity planning, risk management, and project portfolio governance activities.


* Provide regular communication and status reporting to business leadership, IT management, and project governance boards.


* Build and maintain high\-performing SAP support and delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a customer\-focused culture.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**


**Essential**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


* Minimum 12\-15 years of SAP experience with strong understanding of end\-to\-end enterprise business processes.


* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing SAP Application Development (AD) and/or Application Management Services (AMS) teams.


* Proven experience managing SAP projects, enhancements, support services, and vendor delivery engagements.


* Deep functional expertise in Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C), with sufficient understanding of adjacent business processes and modules.


* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Level Management.


* Experience managing managed\-service providers, offshore delivery teams, and external implementation partners.


* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing demands, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex global environment.


* Experience in SAP S/4HANA environments.


* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and decision\-making skills.


* Experience managing project plans, budgets, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.


**Desirable**


* Experience managing both Application Development and AMS functions within a global SAP landscape.


* SAP certification in any functional, technical, or project management discipline.


* ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT Service Management certification.


* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or SAP Activate.


* Basic understanding of ABAP, interfaces, workflows, forms, and SAP development lifecycle.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**


* Office\-based / Remote working model.


* Responsible for ensuring compliance with company Health, Safety, Security, and Risk Management policies.


* Operates within a global support and delivery model supporting business users across APAC, Europe, and the Americas.


* Flexibility to support major incidents, critical project milestones, go\-live activities, and leadership escalations outside standard business hours when required.


* Regular engagement with senior business stakeholders, technology leadership teams, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
